description:
The Naval Surface Warface Center Philadelphia intends to procure two (2) Oil Content Monitors with Datalogger functionality from Admartec, Inc.

The proposed contract action is for supplies or services for which the Government intends to solicit and award with only one source under authority of FAR 13.106(b).

Any questions regarding this notice should be emailed to: brooke.a.steele3.civ@us.navy.mil

Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
